notes.title: Added VR version and materials
notes.notes:
Magic Kaleidoscope VR Expansion Step into the mesmerizing world of Magic Kaleidoscope like never before with our[b] new VR mode![/b]

 Immerse yourself in stunning, interactive 3D environments and explore shaders up close in virtual reality. 

This update also introduces improved screen management, a convenient reset feature for all settings, and seamless access to the material library directly from the menu. Plus, experience two brand-new materials—Rainbow Stars and Living Stone!
